escalations.subject: repo connection cannot exist without an enrollment
escalations.boundary: schema change on a live table with a non-null foreign key
escalations.detail: GitHubConnection.enrollment_id is allowNull:false with an FK to enrollments, and project_id references the student projects table. A commercial client has neither, so a paid DeliveryProject cannot hold a repo connection.
escalations.recommendation: make enrollment_id nullable and add delivery_project_id; the verification loop, token custody and revocation handling are already built and should not be duplicated
